title: Country Climate and Development Report: Armenia
temporal_coverage: Country climate and development assessment with observed risk mapping and modeled climate, flood and poverty outcomes through 2060.
methodology: Opened the full 89-page CCDR; it combines spatial risk assessment, flood maps, household data and economic scenarios.
limitations: Mapped losses and projections are model-based; the report notes asset valuation uncertainty for flood-loss estimates.

title: Fourth National Communication on Climate Change under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change
organization: Ministry of Environment of the Republic of Armenia, with UNDP support
temporal_coverage: Climate observations and hazard impacts through 2017; crop-yield projections through 2070; adaptation measures mainly reported through 2020.
methodology: Opened the full government communication and reviewed its climate, agriculture and adaptation sections.
limitations: The yield tables do not identify an emissions pathway; reported programs are historical and not independently evaluated.

title: National Action Program of Adaptation to Climate Change and the List of Measures for 2021–2025
organization: Government of the Republic of Armenia, Ministry of Environment
temporal_coverage: Government-approved adaptation action program for 2021–2025, with national and marz-level planning measures.
methodology: Opened the government decree and annex listing adaptation measures, responsible agencies, timelines and indicative financing.
limitations: The program states planned actions, not verified implementation or achieved outcomes; its 2021–2025 period has ended.

title: United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework 2026–2030
organization: Government of the Republic of Armenia and United Nations Country Team
temporal_coverage: Joint Government–UN strategy for 2026–2030, signed in Yerevan on 19 December 2025.
methodology: Opened the signed framework and reviewed its national rationale and planned green-transition and disaster-risk measures.
limitations: This is a planning framework, not an evaluation; it does not name pilot municipalities or estimate climate-related displacement.

title: Armenia Floods: May 2024 Post-Disaster Needs Assessment
organization: Government of Armenia, United Nations and European Union
temporal_coverage: Multi-sector assessment of the May 25–26, 2024 floods, their impacts and recovery needs in Lori and Tavush.
methodology: Opened the full Government–UN–EU assessment, including human impacts, gender, housing and disaster-risk sections.
limitations: Event assessment; no attribution to anthropogenic climate change or evaluation of long-term recovery.
